message: I’d like to order one video in Igbo from you. Could we agree on $120 for one video, with delivery next Thursday or Friday? I’ll send you all the information now.
Good evening to you.
Delivery can be completed next Friday. The price for one video is \$165.
Okay, I'll create the offer.
Yes
Please preview the attached copy. If you approve it, I’ll send the high-resolution version without the watermark.
Thank you. I’ve sent it for verification, and I’ll write back once that process is complete. Hello)
Alright
Because the sentence was delivered a little out of context, please make another recording and say it this way: Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a

Please re-record the introduction because the previous version included something outside the supplied text. The required wording is:
"One person wrote to me, такое сообщение" (starts to read the сообщение с телефон):
"I'm constantly losing, it seems to me that something is wrong with the game"
Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a
Would it be possible to move it to next Friday?
Hello
Yes
Is the video ready now? Please let me know. Hello)
I’ll send it to you shortly.
Attached is the corrected copy for your review.

Please make another recording. At the beginning, the translation or delivery of “Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!” was a little poor. It is very important that you read this message correctly from the phone, while everything else must be said exactly according to the script.
Hello)
The revised copy is here.
Please note that once the script is translated into Igbo, its wording runs longer than 90-120secs, so the exact game actions cannot all be read within that duration.

Open with the actor saying:
"Someone sent me a message." (The actor begins reading the message from the phone.)
"I keep losing all the time. It feels like something is wrong with the game." — Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!
(Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! — translation of the message.)
The actor then replies:
"Most likely, you downloaded a fake version where it’s impossible to win!
Let me demonstrate what the fake version looks like.
We’ll play this one first.
The graphics seem strange.
There, we played and lost immediately, right?
That is the fake version.
Next, let’s open the real app.
We’ll play here for a little while.
I’ve already placed my bet at €35, okay?
Notice that the graphics are different here.
Four more steps... great.
€2,480.
I personally controlled every step.
Now let’s withdraw the money.
We’ll wait a moment for the winning confirmation to appear here.
The money is already in my account.
Look, my banking app has already sent a notification.
That’s everything.
See?
The entire process took 12 minutes.
It really is that simple.
This is why many people lose their money: they play through fake apps.
Use the link below the video to download only the official app and earn money just as I do."
Please use the script provided here as your guide, because the video opening was wrong again. Start with this wording, read it carefully, and say it exactly as written.
It’s the introduction script that you keep changing.
The line you sent now differs from the first line shown here.
No, it hasn’t changed. I resent the entire script because you aren’t speaking its wording clearly.
Watch the video; I was reading from the phone.
Good morning. Could you specify exactly what you dislike and point out the lines that sounded unclear? Hello.
Yes, I’ll write out the clarification for you now. Hello)

I really need another reshoot by next Thursday. At the beginning, pretend that you are reading this message from the phone—the same phone you will use to show and play the game: Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! After that opening, say everything exactly as it appears in the script.
Yes
Please review the final shoot I’ve provided.
Once the review is complete, I’ll get back to you; I’ve already submitted the final shoot.
In the video, you mention that someone sent you a message, but you still need to say the content of that message aloud. I’m writing the sentence here; please speak it on camera:
This is the message being spoken aloud in the video: Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!
I can see now that you did say it, although perhaps my translation is poor.
That sentence was already spoken in the video.
Yes, I spoke that sentence in the video.
yes yes
If it’s the same thing, why is it being requested again?
No, I’m not asking for it again. The video has been sent for verification, and I’m waiting for the customer’s response.
Mirela, I’m still waiting for your feedback; none has come through yet. Hi.
I’m sorry—hello. I’m still waiting for the customer’s answer.
Unfortunately, the video once again does not follow the script text. Since there is no time left for another reshoot and the video was not executed correctly, may I cancel this contract, please?
Was the text reviewed by the same person?
I delivered according to the script, and this job consumed my time and resources.
Yes, the same person reviewed it. The opening was spoken incorrectly again, even though it is a particularly important part of the script. Everything must be delivered exactly as the script says.
Because we won’t use your video and there isn’t enough time for a reshoot, I unfortunately have to cancel the offer.
Igbo is my first language, and I spoke it correctly.
Sure do
